comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber; record extinguishes a pan fire from behind a tape line.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision mechanical tool work and physical test controls; record requires extinguisher acquisition, aiming, and discharge while maintaining distance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures stroke, rebound, overload, hard-stop avoidance, and setting drift. Record requires extinguishing the fire from behind the line but provides no formal specs or distance/extinguishment thresholds.
comparison.reason: Fire suppression tests aiming, discharge, and spatial safety rather than mechanical adjustment and dynamic deceleration.
